story_type: overdue fishermen adrift far offshore, aircraft drop survival kits, merchant ship pickup
hook: Last seen heading out to fish. Found 307 miles away.
narration: Three fishermen went out to sea and never came back. A Navy plane found them three hundred seven miles away.
They had left Christmas Island, in the Pacific nation of Kiribati, in a small open boat.
The P-8 dropped them food and water. A Coast Guard C-130 dropped a radio and a locator beacon.
A beacon sends its position to satellites, so rescuers never lose the boat.
outcome: The merchant ship Linnix rescued all three and carried them back to Christmas Island.
title: Fishermen found 307 miles off course
description:
In August 2021 the Coast Guard, the Navy and the merchant vessel Linnix rescued three overdue mariners near Christmas Island, Kiribati, after a Navy P-8 Poseidon found them 307 miles west of where they set out.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Barbers Point, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/810135/coast-guard-partners-rescue-3-overdue-mariners-kiribati
